blocks.en: 다. How to write the main text: Write the thesis on the front side of each page only. As a rule, the font size is 10 points for Korean and 11 points for English. The main text uses double spacing as standard. Put page numbers at the bottom centre: lowercase Roman numerals from the abstract to the list of tables, and Arabic numerals from the main text to the acknowledgements. Notes use single spacing as standard. Apart from notes, do not insert headers or footers. In the main text, mark citations with square brackets [] at the relevant place, in the same font size as the main text. Introduction [1] Looking at the history of wireless communication, it is no exaggeration to say that several wars led to major leaps forward. This is because key engineering applications of electromagnetics, including radar, became possible through national investment and concentrated research effort aimed at winning wars... In other words, modern warfare has grown from the physical warfare of the past into electronic warfare (Electric warfare), in which engineering technology itself is military power. Modern electronic warfare is fought by defending the radio signals of one's own wireless communication devices and radar against attack, and by disabling the enemy's electronic communication devices. In particular, research on power amplifiers that transmit high-power radio waves to disable the enemy's electromagnetic signals and to jam (jamming) improvised explosive devices has become important and has been very active. Because such power amplifiers target signals of any frequency, high output power and broadband operation are their key performance features. Writing Degree Theses in ECE: The concept of a thesis; Structure of a thesis; Citing references and research ethics; The thesis writing process 1 2 3 4 Self-check with AI: “This is actually what a student wrote at the start of the introduction of a bachelor's thesis. If professors in the field criticised this part during the review, what would their reasons be?” Introduction [1] Broadband amplifiers, which must amplify signals over a wide band, are well known to be difficult to design, even within the field of microwave (ultra-high-frequency) circuit design. Even setting aside the general difficulty of microwave amplifier design, impedance matching, a step every microwave design must go through, is not fixed at one specific frequency, so perfect matching is impossible. In addition, in theory the output power and gain of a transistor are inversely proportional to the square of the frequency, so circuit performance can change with the frequency of the incoming signal. To solve these problems and design microwave circuits with high performance over 1 decade or more of bandwidth, various circuits such as balanced amplifiers and feedback circuits have been proposed as candidates. Among them, the distributed amplifier (Distributed Amplifier, DA), first proposed in the 1940s, has attracted great attention because it gives uniform gain over a relatively wide band. This amplifier is based on transmission line theory, and it has the further advantages that it is easier to design and build than other amplifier circuits and that its principle is intuitive to understand. Introduction [1] Against this background, this study designed a distributed amplifier with a gain of 10dB or more from the L band to the C band, which are widely used bands. It uses a GaAs HEMT (High Electron Mobility Transistor), a device often used at microwave and millimetre-wave frequencies. The L band, S band and C band defined by IEEE are frequency bands with high military use; they are allocated to radar, military mobile surveillance sets, missile controllers and so on [5]. Section 2.1 of Chapter 2 (Main Body) introduces various broadband amplifiers, and….. Chapter 3 (Conclusion) summarises the study and discusses its limitations and significance.
blocks.ko: 다. 본문 작성 요령 논문의 내용은 앞면만 사용하여 작성한다 글자크기는 국문의 경우 10포인트, 영문의 경우 11포인트로 하는 것을 원칙으로 한다 본문은 두 줄 띄기(double spacing)를 기준으로 한다. 페이지는 하단 중앙에 표기, 초록부터 표 목차까지 로마자 소문자로 본문부터 감사문까지는 아라비아 숫자로 표기한다 주는 한 줄 띄기(single spacing)를 기준으로 작성하며 주를 제외한 머리말과 꼬릿말은 넣지 않는다 본문에서의 참고문헌 인용은 해당부분에 대괄호 []로 표시, 본문과 같은 크기의 글자를 사용한다. 서론 [1] 무선 통신 발전의 역사를 살펴보면, 몇 번의 전쟁이 큰 약진을 이끌었다고 해도 과언이 아니다. 레이더를 비롯한 전자기학의 주요한 공학적 응용이 전쟁에 승리하기 위한 국가적 투자와 연구 역량의 집중으로 가능해졌기 때문이다...다시 말해, 현대 전쟁은 과거와 같은 물리전이라기보다, 공학적 기술력이 곧 군사력이 되는 전자전(Electric warfare)의 차원으로 확대되었다. 현대의 전자전은 아군의 무선통신기기 및 레이더에 대한 전파신호를 공격으로부터 방어하고 적군의 전자통신기기를 무력화 하는 방식으로 벌어진다. 그 중에서도 특히 상대방의 전자기파 신호를 무력화 하기 위해 고출력의 전파를 송출하고, 급조 폭발물을 재밍(jamming)하기 위한 용도의 전력증폭기 개발 연구는 그 중요성이 부각돼 활발하게 진행되어 왔다. 이러한 전력증폭기는 임의의 주파수 신호를 대상으로 하므로 고출력과 광대역의 특성을 주요 성능으로 삼고 있다. 전기∙정보공학부 학위논문 작성법 논문의 개념 논문의 구성 참고문헌 인용과 연구윤리 학위논문 작성과정 1 2 3 4 Self-check with AI 이건 실제로 학생이 학사 학위논문의 서론 첫 부분에 쓴 내용이야. 이 부분을 심사할 때 전공 교수들이 비판한다면 어떤 이유에서 일까? 서론 [1] 광대역의 신호를 대상으로 증폭해야 하는 광대역 증폭기는 초고주파수 회로 설계 분야에서도 설계하기가 까다롭기로 잘 알려져 있다. 초고주파수 증폭기 설계의 어려움을 차치하고라도 초고주파수 설계가 반드시 거쳐야 하는 임피던스 정합(impedance matching)이 특정 주파수로 고정되지 않아 완벽한 정합이 불가능하기 때문이다. 뿐만 아니라 이론적으로 알려진 트랜지스터의 출력 전력 및 이득은 주파수의 제곱에 반비례하게 되므로, 수용하는 신호의 주파수에 따라 회로의 성능이 달라질 수 있다. 이러한 문제를 해결하고 광대역에서 1-decade 이상의 고성능을 보일 수 있는 초고주파수회로를 설계하기 위해 평형증폭기, 피드백 회로 등 다양한 회로들이 후보로 제시됐다. 그 중에서도 1940년대에 처음으로 제안된 분산증폭기(Distributed Amplifier, DA)는 비교적 큰 대역에서 균일한 이득을 얻을 수 있어 큰 주목을 받아왔다. 전송선 이론(Transmission line theory)을 기반으로 하는 이 증폭기는 그 구현에 있어 설계가 다른 증폭기 회로에 비해 용이하고 그 원리를 직관적으로 이해할 수 있다는 장점을 추가적으로 확보하고 있다. 서론 [1] 이러한 배경아래 본 연구에서는 초고주파 및 밀리미터파에서 자주 활용되는 GaAs HEMT(High Electron Mobility Transistor)를 이용해, 활용도가 높은 L밴드부터 C밴드에서 10dB이상 이득을 보이는 분산증폭기를 설계했다. IEEE에서 규정한 L밴드, S밴드, C밴드는 레이더, 군용 이동형 감시 세트, 미사일 제어기 등에 할당돼 있는 등 군사적 활용도가 높은 주파수 대역이다 [5]. 2장 본론의 2.1절에서는 다양한 광대역 증폭기들에 대해서 소개하고….. 3장 결론에서는 연구를 요약하고 연구의 한계점, 의의를 다룬다.

Introduction: Importance of the research subject; Background knowledge on the research subject; Problems with the research subject; Previous studies on these problems; Limitations and problems of previous studies; Specific research question; Overview of this study. blocks.en: 3. Conclusion [1] Various topologies have been proposed over time to design broadband amplifiers, which are widely used, for example for military purposes. In this paper, a broadband amplifier was designed and built using a GaAs HEMT, based on the distributed amplifier topology. Various circuit design techniques had to be introduced to overcome the limited performance of the device itself. For this, the Cascade structure traditionally used in electronic circuits and the Series gate capacitor technique, which uses the characteristics of microwave circuits, were applied. Analysis of the measurement results based on S-parameters showed that a circuit with the desired performance was obtained. In this study, the devices that could physically be used were limited. That is, the uniformity and reliability of the devices could not be verified. In addition, the power efficiency of operating the power amplifier was not considered. Therefore, improved results could be expected if the same circuit were built and measured in a more controlled environment. Also, if energy efficiency were addressed by taking power consumption into account, the study could be considered more practical. Unlike conventional electronic circuit design, microwave circuit design requires understanding the characteristics of high-frequency signals in the circuit and, at the same time, considering transmission lines and the radiation and loss of electromagnetic waves. In this context, research on distributed amplifiers made it possible to understand transmission lines and active devices such as transistors more accurately from a microwave perspective. Furthermore, it helped in mastering the principles of amplifying broadband signals. Research question; Research summary; Significance of the research; Limitations of the research; Suggestions for future research. How to write the abstract (Appendix Table 3)
blocks.ko: 3. 결론 [1] 군사적 용도 등으로 사용돼 활용도가 높은 광대역 증폭기를 설계하기 위해 역사적으로 다양한 토폴로지가 제안되어 왔다. 본고에서는 분산증폭기의 토폴로지를 기반으로 GaAs HEMT를 이용해 광대역 증폭기를 설계 및 제작하였다. 소자 자체의 제한된 성능을 극복하기 위해 다양한 회로설계 기법을 도입해야 했다. 이를 위해 전자회로에서 전통적으로 사용하는 Cascade 구조와 초고주파회로의 특성을 이용한 Series gate capacitor 기법을 활용했다. S-파라미터를 기반으로 측정결과를 분석한 결과, 원하는 성능의 회로를 확보할 수 있었다. 이번 연구에서는 물리적으로 사용할 수 있는 소자가 제한되어 있었다. 즉, 소자의 균일성, 신뢰도를 검증하지 못했다. 뿐만 아니라, 전력 증폭기를 동작시키기 위한 전력의 효율성 측면도 고려하지 않았다. 따라서 같은 회로를 보다 통제된 환경에서 제작, 측정했다면 개선된 결과를 기대할 수 있을 것으로 생각된다. 또 소모전력을 고려해 에너지 효율성의 문제도 함께 다룰 수 있다면 보다 실효성 있는 연구로 평가할 수 있겠다. 초고주파 회로 설계는 기존의 전자회로 설계와는 다르게 회로의 고주파수 신호의 특성을 이해할 수 있어야 하고 전송선과 전자기파의 방사 및 손실 등을 동시에 고려해야 한다. 이러한 맥락에서 분산증폭기 연구는 초고주파수 관점에서 전송선과 트랜지스터와 같은 능동소자를 보다 정확히 이해할 수 있게 해주었다. 더 나아가 광대역 신호의 증폭 원리를 체득하는 데 도움을 주었다. 연구문제 연구요약 연구의의 연구한계 연구제언 초록 작성요령 (별표 3)

Abstract [1]: Freely include the information needed so that someone can cite your thesis after reading only the abstract. In this study, a broadband distributed amplifier covering the L band to the C band was implemented. Among the various known broadband amplifier circuits, the distributed amplifier (Distributed Amplifiers, DA) has the advantages of being relatively easy to build and giving uniform performance over a wide band. The device used in this study is Fujitsu's FJS35LG, a ceramic-packaged 250nm-gate low-noise HEMT device. It was chosen to obtain gain up to high frequencies reaching the C band with a hybrid approach, without using an MMIC process. To overcome the performance loss caused by packaging, the Cascade structure and the series gate capacitor technique were additionally applied. This paper gives an overview of broadband amplifiers and covers the principles of the distributed amplifier, the matching circuit design, and general aspects of circuit implementation. Keywords: broadband amplifier, distributed amplifier, series gate capacitor, GaAs HEMT, circuit design. What is a thesis? New and useful knowledge ♦ Being first ♦ Previous studies. Abstract translation (Translated with DeepL.com free version) This study implemented a broadband distributed amplifier covering the L-band to C-band frequency range. Among various known broadband amplifier circuits, distributed amplifiers (DAs) offer the advantages of relatively simple fabrication and consistent performance across a wide bandwidth. The device used in this study is Fujitsu's FJS35LG, a 250nm gate low-noise HEMT device in a ceramic package. It was selected for its ability to achieve high gain up to the C-band frequency range using a hybrid approach, without requiring an MMIC process. To overcome performance degradation due to packaging, a cascade structure and series gate capacitor technique were additionally applied. This paper provides an overview of broadband amplifiers, covering the principles of distributed amplifiers, corresponding circuit design, and general aspects of circuit implementation. It was selected for its ability to achieve high gain up to the C-band frequency range using a hybrid approach, without requiring an MMIC process. To overcome performance degradation due to packaging, a cascade structure and series gate capacitor technique were additionally applied. This paper provides an overview of broadband amplifiers, covering the principles of distributed amplifiers, corresponding circuit design, and general aspects of circuit implementation. 공과대학 전기‧정보공학부 학사 학위논문 작성지침

In the reference list, indent the lines to align with the first line so that only the numbers show on the left. In-text Citation: ...Research on distributed amplifiers made it possible to understand transmission lines and active devices such as transistors more accurately from a microwave perspective. Furthermore, it helped in mastering the principles of amplifying broadband signals. ► Direct quotation: According to 방준휘 (Bang Jun-hwi), research on distributed amplifiers is an opportunity to “understand transmission lines and active devices such as transistors more accurately” [1, p. 19]. ► Indirect quotation (an indirect quotation that only changes a few words is plagiarism!): Research on distributed amplifiers improves understanding of active devices and helps in mastering the principles of broadband signal amplification [1]. Through extensive research on distributed amplifiers, knowledge of active devices and of the principles of broadband signal amplification can be developed [1], and on this basis, it can become easier to control the various variables required in microwave circuit design. It is an indirect quotation only if it includes your own interpretation.

blocks.en: ※ Things to know when writing the thesis: Each student must submit their own thesis (not 1 per lab group). Binding is not required, but submit it in a book-like form.
